column1: Rainfall measured in inches from the north lot and and the shop every morning by the Guana rangers
In April 2022, water level recordings started by using binoculars to read the level off the staff gauge at the south end of Guana Lake. The gauge is manitained by FWC.
Water level readings are unitless and relative to a surveyed elevation. Contact FWC for more details.
Shop: (30.024312, -81.325823) Located on a post near the radio tower, directly behind the kayak trailer.
North Lot: (30.117236, -81.346015) Mounted on the left side of the entrance gate.
